# Once Upon A Park Day

> Plain-English guides to Disney and Universal resort hotels, Disney Cruise Line ships, and trip planning for first-time visitors. Independent site, not affiliated with The Walt Disney Company or Universal Orlando Resort.

Each resort guide covers who the hotel suits, rooms, pools, dining, getting to the parks, pros and cons, and first-timer tips. Guides marked "first-hand" are written from the author's own stays; others are researched and say so on the page.

## Walt Disney World resort guides

- [Disney's All-Star Movies Resort](https://once-upon-a-park-day.pages.dev/resorts/all-star-movies/): Value resort, Animal Kingdom area. Bright, playful buildings decorated with giant icons from classic Disney films.
- [Disney's All-Star Music Resort](https://once-upon-a-park-day.pages.dev/resorts/all-star-music/): Value resort, Animal Kingdom area. Music-themed buildings with oversized instruments, plus family suites for bigger groups.
- [Disney's All-Star Sports Resort](https://once-upon-a-park-day.pages.dev/resorts/all-star-sports/): Value resort, Animal Kingdom area. Sports-themed buildings with supersized balls, helmets and courts.
- [Disney's Pop Century Resort](https://once-upon-a-park-day.pages.dev/resorts/pop-century/): Value resort, Wide World of Sports area. A walk through 20th-century pop culture, decade by decade, across the lake from Art of Animation.
- [Disney's Art of Animation Resort](https://once-upon-a-park-day.pages.dev/resorts/art-of-animation/): Value resort, Wide World of Sports area. Themed to animated films, with most rooms set up as family suites.
- [Disney's Caribbean Beach Resort](https://once-upon-a-park-day.pages.dev/resorts/caribbean-beach/): Moderate resort, Epcot area. Colorful Caribbean island villages around a lake, and the central hub of the Skyliner.
- [Disney's Coronado Springs Resort](https://once-upon-a-park-day.pages.dev/resorts/coronado-springs/): Moderate resort, Animal Kingdom area. Spanish and Mexican-inspired buildings around a large lake, including the Gran Destino Tower.
- [Disney's Port Orleans Resort – French Quarter](https://once-upon-a-park-day.pages.dev/resorts/port-orleans-french-quarter/): Moderate resort, Disney Springs area. A compact resort styled after the French Quarter of New Orleans.
- [Disney's Port Orleans Resort – Riverside](https://once-upon-a-park-day.pages.dev/resorts/port-orleans-riverside/): Moderate resort, Disney Springs area. Southern riverside mansions and bayou-style buildings along a winding river.
- [Disney's Animal Kingdom Lodge](https://once-upon-a-park-day.pages.dev/resorts/animal-kingdom-lodge/): Deluxe resort, Animal Kingdom area. An African-inspired lodge where many rooms look out over savannas with live animals.
- [Disney's Beach Club Resort](https://once-upon-a-park-day.pages.dev/resorts/beach-club/): Deluxe resort, Epcot area. A breezy New England seaside hotel, sharing a large sand-bottom pool area with the Yacht Club.
- [Disney's BoardWalk Inn](https://once-upon-a-park-day.pages.dev/resorts/boardwalk-inn/): Deluxe resort, Epcot area. A turn-of-the-century Atlantic seaboard boardwalk on Crescent Lake, with shops and restaurants outside the door.
- [Disney's Contemporary Resort](https://once-upon-a-park-day.pages.dev/resorts/contemporary/): Deluxe resort, Magic Kingdom area. A modern A-frame tower that the monorail runs right through, a short walk from Magic Kingdom.
- [Disney's Grand Floridian Resort & Spa](https://once-upon-a-park-day.pages.dev/resorts/grand-floridian/): Deluxe resort, Magic Kingdom area. A Victorian-style seaside hotel on the Seven Seas Lagoon, and Walt Disney World's flagship resort. (first-hand guide)
- [Disney's Polynesian Village Resort](https://once-upon-a-park-day.pages.dev/resorts/polynesian-village/): Deluxe resort, Magic Kingdom area. A South Pacific island resort on the Seven Seas Lagoon, looking across the water to Magic Kingdom.
- [Disney's Wilderness Lodge](https://once-upon-a-park-day.pages.dev/resorts/wilderness-lodge/): Deluxe resort, Magic Kingdom area. A grand national park lodge with a towering lobby, set in the woods on Bay Lake.
- [Disney's Yacht Club Resort](https://once-upon-a-park-day.pages.dev/resorts/yacht-club/): Deluxe resort, Epcot area. A polished New England yacht club, sharing a large sand-bottom pool area with the Beach Club. (first-hand guide)
- [Bay Lake Tower at Disney's Contemporary Resort](https://once-upon-a-park-day.pages.dev/resorts/bay-lake-tower/): Deluxe Villa resort, Magic Kingdom area. A Disney Vacation Club tower next to the Contemporary, linked to it by a skybridge.
- [Boulder Ridge Villas at Disney's Wilderness Lodge](https://once-upon-a-park-day.pages.dev/resorts/boulder-ridge-villas/): Deluxe Villa resort, Magic Kingdom area. Disney Vacation Club villas inside the Wilderness Lodge, styled after the railroad era of the American West.
- [Copper Creek Villas & Cabins at Disney's Wilderness Lodge](https://once-upon-a-park-day.pages.dev/resorts/copper-creek-villas/): Deluxe Villa resort, Magic Kingdom area. Disney Vacation Club villas inside the Wilderness Lodge, plus standalone cabins along Bay Lake.
- [Disney's Old Key West Resort](https://once-upon-a-park-day.pages.dev/resorts/old-key-west/): Deluxe Villa resort, Disney Springs area. A laid-back Key West-style resort with roomy villas, near Disney Springs.
- [Disney's Saratoga Springs Resort & Spa](https://once-upon-a-park-day.pages.dev/resorts/saratoga-springs/): Deluxe Villa resort, Disney Springs area. A large resort inspired by the spa and horse-racing towns of upstate New York, across the lake from Disney Springs.
- [Disney's Riviera Resort](https://once-upon-a-park-day.pages.dev/resorts/riviera/): Deluxe Villa resort, Epcot area. An elegant European Riviera-style resort with its own Skyliner station.
- [Disney's Polynesian Villas & Bungalows](https://once-upon-a-park-day.pages.dev/resorts/polynesian-villas/): Deluxe Villa resort, Magic Kingdom area. Disney Vacation Club villas at the Polynesian, plus bungalows that sit over the Seven Seas Lagoon.
- [Island Tower at Disney's Polynesian Villas & Bungalows](https://once-upon-a-park-day.pages.dev/resorts/island-tower/): Deluxe Villa resort, Magic Kingdom area. The newest Disney Vacation Club tower at the Polynesian, on the Seven Seas Lagoon.
- [The Villas at Disney's Grand Floridian Resort & Spa](https://once-upon-a-park-day.pages.dev/resorts/grand-floridian-villas/): Deluxe Villa resort, Magic Kingdom area. Disney Vacation Club villas in the same Victorian style as the Grand Floridian next door.
- [Disney's Animal Kingdom Villas – Kidani Village](https://once-upon-a-park-day.pages.dev/resorts/kidani-village/): Deluxe Villa resort, Animal Kingdom area. Disney Vacation Club villas next to Animal Kingdom Lodge, with their own savanna views.
- [Disney's Beach Club Villas](https://once-upon-a-park-day.pages.dev/resorts/beach-club-villas/): Deluxe Villa resort, Epcot area. Disney Vacation Club villas attached to the Beach Club, with access to the same pool area.
- [Disney's BoardWalk Villas](https://once-upon-a-park-day.pages.dev/resorts/boardwalk-villas/): Deluxe Villa resort, Epcot area. Disney Vacation Club villas on the BoardWalk, sharing the building with the BoardWalk Inn.
- [The Cabins at Disney's Fort Wilderness Resort](https://once-upon-a-park-day.pages.dev/resorts/cabins-at-fort-wilderness/): Deluxe Villa resort, Magic Kingdom area. Disney Vacation Club cabins tucked into the woods at Fort Wilderness.
- [Disney's Fort Wilderness Resort & Campground](https://once-upon-a-park-day.pages.dev/resorts/fort-wilderness/): Campground resort, Magic Kingdom area. Wooded campsites for tents and RVs on Bay Lake, with trails, horses and campfire evenings.

## Disneyland Resort hotel guides

- [Disney's Grand Californian Hotel & Spa](https://once-upon-a-park-day.pages.dev/disneyland/hotels/grand-californian/): A California Craftsman lodge with redwood and Monterey pine details, right beside Disney California Adventure.
- [Disneyland Hotel](https://once-upon-a-park-day.pages.dev/disneyland/hotels/disneyland-hotel/): The resort's original hotel from 1955, with mid-century style and towers that nod to the early lands of Disneyland.
- [Pixar Place Hotel](https://once-upon-a-park-day.pages.dev/disneyland/hotels/pixar-place/): A 15-story tower themed to Pixar films, the first fully Pixar-themed hotel in the United States.
- [The Villas at Disneyland Hotel](https://once-upon-a-park-day.pages.dev/disneyland/hotels/villas-at-disneyland-hotel/): A Disney Vacation Club tower at the Disneyland Hotel, themed to classic Walt Disney Animation films.

## Universal Orlando Resort hotel guides

- [Loews Portofino Bay Hotel](https://once-upon-a-park-day.pages.dev/universal-orlando/hotels/portofino-bay/): Signature Collection. An Italian seaside village by the water, modeled on the town of Portofino.
- [Hard Rock Hotel](https://once-upon-a-park-day.pages.dev/universal-orlando/hotels/hard-rock-hotel/): Signature Collection. A music-themed hotel filled with rock memorabilia, closest of the Signature hotels to the main parks.
- [Loews Royal Pacific Resort](https://once-upon-a-park-day.pages.dev/universal-orlando/hotels/royal-pacific/): Signature Collection. A South Pacific island escape with lush, tropical grounds.
- [Loews Sapphire Falls Resort](https://once-upon-a-park-day.pages.dev/universal-orlando/hotels/sapphire-falls/): Signature Collection. A Caribbean island resort built around waterfalls and a lagoon.
- [Universal Helios Grand Hotel, a Loews Hotel](https://once-upon-a-park-day.pages.dev/universal-orlando/hotels/helios-grand/): Signature Collection. A celestial-themed grand hotel inside Epic Universe, with its own entrance into the park.
- [Universal Aventura Hotel](https://once-upon-a-park-day.pages.dev/universal-orlando/hotels/aventura/): Prime Value. A sleek, modern high-rise with a rooftop bar.
- [Universal Stella Nova Resort](https://once-upon-a-park-day.pages.dev/universal-orlando/hotels/stella-nova/): Prime Value. A space-age hotel inspired by the stars and constellations, next to Epic Universe. Opened in 2025.
- [Universal Terra Luna Resort](https://once-upon-a-park-day.pages.dev/universal-orlando/hotels/terra-luna/): Prime Value. Stella Nova's twin, with a bright, otherworldly look near Epic Universe.
- [Universal Cabana Bay Beach Resort](https://once-upon-a-park-day.pages.dev/universal-orlando/hotels/cabana-bay/): Value Inns & Suites. A retro 1950s and 1960s beach-motel look, with family suites and plenty to do.
- [Universal Endless Summer Resort – Surfside Inn and Suites](https://once-upon-a-park-day.pages.dev/universal-orlando/hotels/endless-summer-surfside/): Value Inns & Suites. A laid-back surf and beach theme at one of Universal's lowest prices.
- [Universal Endless Summer Resort – Dockside Inn and Suites](https://once-upon-a-park-day.pages.dev/universal-orlando/hotels/endless-summer-dockside/): Value Inns & Suites. Surfside's sister hotel, with the same beachy theme and value pricing.

## Disney Cruise Line ship guides

- [All Disney Cruise Line ships compared](https://once-upon-a-park-day.pages.dev/cruises/)
- [Disney Magic](https://once-upon-a-park-day.pages.dev/cruises/disney-magic/): Disney's original ship, with a classic Art Deco look and a cozier size than the newer ships.
- [Disney Wonder](https://once-upon-a-park-day.pages.dev/cruises/disney-wonder/): The Magic's sister ship, with an Art Nouveau look and the same classic, smaller-ship feel.
- [Disney Dream](https://once-upon-a-park-day.pages.dev/cruises/disney-dream/): The first of the larger ships, which introduced the AquaDuck water coaster and virtual portholes in inside staterooms.
- [Disney Fantasy](https://once-upon-a-park-day.pages.dev/cruises/disney-fantasy/): The Dream's sister ship, with an Art Nouveau look, often sailing longer Caribbean itineraries.
- [Disney Wish](https://once-upon-a-park-day.pages.dev/cruises/disney-wish/): The first of the newest generation of ships, with a grand fairy-tale atrium and new themed dining.
- [Disney Treasure](https://once-upon-a-park-day.pages.dev/cruises/disney-treasure/): The Wish's sister ship, themed around adventure and exploration.
- [Disney Destiny](https://once-upon-a-park-day.pages.dev/cruises/disney-destiny/): Disney's heroes-and-villains ship and the third in the Wish class, launched in late 2025.
- [Disney Adventure](https://once-upon-a-park-day.pages.dev/cruises/disney-adventure/): Disney's largest ship, built for 3- and 4-night sailings from Singapore.
- [Disney Believe](https://once-upon-a-park-day.pages.dev/cruises/disney-believe/): Disney's next ship, scheduled to sail its maiden voyage in December 2027 from Fort Lauderdale.
